description: This file defines the interface `ISwitchBoard` within the `WPEFramework::Exchange` namespace. It provides virtual methods for managing switchboard notifications and controlling the active state of callsigns, including registering/unregistering notifications, checking activity status, and activating/deactivating callsigns.

classes.name: ISwitchBoard
classes.description: Interface for switchboard management, allowing registration of notifications, activation, deactivation, and status inquiries related to callsigns.

classes.name: ISwitchBoard::INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for receiving notifications when a callsign is activated.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification object to receive switchboard events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification object.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks whether a callsign is currently active.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a callsign and returns a status code.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a callsign and returns a status code.
